About

Our Story

Butler Hall Productions grew out of a friendship that began decades ago, when three future partners met during their first year of college.

Years later, a renewed connection and a shared passion for storytelling brought them together again. That reunion evolved into a creative partnership dedicated to developing compelling, original entertainment.

Today, Butler Hall Productions brings together distinct perspectives and creative experiences, united by a simple philosophy: Strong Stories, Well Told.

THE PARTNERS

Active Nearby

A Los Angeles casting director navigating modern dating becomes entangled in a mysterious Snapless chat connection while his circle of friends wrestles with love, ambition, and reinvention.

TELEVISION

Merwin Point

The Merwin family turns the Connecticut oyster trade into a fortune in 1880s Milford. Rivals, corruption and labor unrest close in from outside, while ambition and betrayal fracture the dynasty from within.

FEATURE FILM

The Boards

A shy Jersey teen takes a summer job on the Seaside Heights boardwalk in 1992 and falls hard for the hustles, a first love and a reckless best friend. As summer ends, he must choose between staying on The Boards or walking away.

TELEVISION

Transit Stories

Anthology series about a group of commuters in one city during one year experiencing the vicissitudes of life.

FEATURE FILM

Shucked

A Boston food writer trades her desk job for a year of mud, tides and hard labor on a Duxbury oyster farm. She learns the trade from the ground up and finds more than she bargained for.
